description: Source code for generating TypeScript protocol type definitions from browser debugging protocols, including functions for Chromium, WebKit, and Firefox, utilizing external modules like 'path', 'fs', 'node-stream-zip', 'vm', and 'os'.

methods.name: generateProtocol
methods.description: Main function to generate protocol definitions for specified browser engine ('chromium', 'firefox', 'webkit').

methods.name: generateChromiumProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript definitions for Chromium protocol by launching a browser instance, retrieving protocol JSON, and converting it to TypeScript.

methods.name: generateWebKitProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript definitions for WebKit protocol by reading a JSON file and converting it to TypeScript.

methods.name: generateFirefoxProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript definitions for Firefox protocol by extracting and processing protocol JavaScript from a ZIP archive.

methods.name: jsonToTS
methods.description: Converts protocol JSON object into TypeScript namespace definitions.

methods.name: firefoxJSONToTS
methods.description: Converts Firefox protocol JSON into TypeScript namespace definitions.

methods.name: typeOfProperty
methods.description: Determines TypeScript type string from protocol property definitions.

methods.name: firefoxTypeToString
